\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-61},
  title = {An omitted equipment list is read as empty},
  date = {2026-10-01},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Feature Encoding, API Design, Evaluation Protocol},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {A request that omits one of the four equipment lists is read as an empty list, so every column that list produces reaches the model as \texttt{False} and not as missing.
\texttt{Model.\allowbreak{}mask\_\allowbreak{}absent} is the single implementation of what an omitted field is, for the API, for SC-06's masking sweep and for the tests.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Omitted means absent, with missing values across the list's columns: what EDN-15 asks for in general, but no listing has a null list, so the model would score a state it was never fitted on.
\item Leave it to each caller: the docstrings said both things at once, and the obvious one-line masking silently chose the missing-value reading.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} No measurement decides: on the test set the two readings give identical predictions for the LightGBM variants.
That is a property of the tree models and would not hold for a model with missingness indicators, so the rule is fixed on meaning.
An empty list is a state the training data holds; an absent one is not.
An API model that passes the field on as \texttt{None} would choose the other reading, so it defaults to \texttt{[]}.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Rejected},
  assessment = {A first AI review of PR \#62 found the contradiction and recommended the empty list.
A second AI pass argued from the contract's wording for missing values, recommended that and implemented it.
Lukas overruled the second pass on a ground neither had weighed: the training data has no null list.
A figure the second pass gave for its option came from an error in its own probe.
The shared helper is AI's and stayed.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-30 (review of PR \#62) and 2026-10-01.},
  evidence = {\texttt{Model.\allowbreak{}mask\_\allowbreak{}absent} in \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/modeling/model.py}{\texttt{model.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/tests/test_model.py}{\texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}model.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/62}{PR \#62}.},
